name: ghost-docker
title: Sığınak — Ghost 5 newsletter
description: Stock Ghost 5 + MySQL 8 on Docker with a bind-mounted custom Handlebars theme and routes.yaml (/newsletter/ channel, /archive/); owner account, theme activation and sample content are provisioned through the Admin API by an idempotent script.

env.name: GHOST_URL
env.description: Public URL of the site; change to the deployed domain

env.name: MAIL_TRANSPORT
env.description: Ghost mail transport; SMTP + mail__options__* for real mail

env.name: STAFF_DEVICE_VERIFICATION
env.description: Keep false without SMTP or admin logins fail (Ghost e-mails a device code)

env.name: GHOST_OWNER_EMAIL
env.description: Owner login e-mail created by setup-owner.sh

env.name: GHOST_OWNER_PASSWORD
env.description: Owner password (min 10 chars) created by setup-owner.sh

auth.description: Ghost admin session: POST /ghost/api/admin/session/ (JSON username/password + Origin header) sets a cookie used by /ghost/ and the Admin API; Admin API returns 403 without it. Public site, RSS and /ghost/api/admin/site/ are anonymous.

persistence: Named volumes db_data (MySQL) and ghost_content (/var/lib/ghost/content: images, files, logs). Theme (content/themes/siginak) and content/settings/routes.yaml are bind-mounted from the repo. Owner, settings, page and posts are created by scripts/setup-owner.sh when missing.
notes: Docker-only. After `docker compose up -d`, wait for GET /ghost/api/admin/site/ = 200 (Ghost needs ~20 s to create its MySQL schema on first boot) and run scripts/setup-owner.sh once (idempotent; needs curl + python3 on the host). Without it the site is up but /ghost/ shows Ghost's setup wizard and the default Casper theme is active. Only port 8010 is published; MySQL is internal. No SMTP is configured, so member e-mails/newsletters are not sent; STAFF_DEVICE_VERIFICATION must stay false unless SMTP is configured. GHOST_URL must equal the externally visible URL or Ghost will generate wrong links/redirects.
